# Selected source-labeled anime calls

The current companion calls use four recordings from the visible Anime Cry players on Psypoke, listed separately there from game-cry players.

- **Pikachu** — [source player](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/psydex/025), [original recording](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/crydex/anime/025.mp3).
- **Bulbasaur** — [source player](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/psydex/001), [original recording](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/crydex/anime/001.mp3).
- **Charmander** — [source player](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/psydex/004), [original recording](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/crydex/anime/004.mp3).
- **Charizard** — [source player](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/psydex/006), [original recording](https://www.psypokes.com/dex/crydex/anime/006.mp3).

Modifications: mono conversion, resampling to 32 kHz, gain adjustment, 64 kbit/s MP3 encoding and a 6 ms entry fade. No pitch or tempo changes and no synthetic voice generation.

The source labels these as anime calls. Dub language, episode, recording performer and authenticity are not independently established; the recordings are not certified Japanese voices. Vaporeon and Articuno use the separately credited game cries. Snorlax is silent.

Psypoke is a third-party fan source. The recordings are retained at the owner’s request for review before publishing. Public player/download access does not establish a rightsholder redistribution license. No such permission or official affiliation is asserted.
